Join Evoke, a leading global online gaming and entertainment company, be part of an
exciting industry that provides thrilling experiences to millions of players worldwide. With a
strong presence in the market, 888&WH offers a dynamic and innovative work
environment, fostering growth, creativity, and collaboration. Join our talented team of
professionals and contribute to our continued success in delivering top-quality gaming
products and services. Unlock your potential with 888&WH and embark on a rewarding
career in the ever-evolving world of online gaming.
 What You Will Be Doing
 Develop integration platform with 3rd party worldwide game providers
 Develop, Enhance and Maintain existing gaming platform, game engines and provide
 development support for Casino infra applications.
 Experience in all aspects of application development lifecycle (analysis and design to
 implementation and support)
 Working closely with different interfaces such as Product/Project managers, Statisticians,
 Front-end game developers, QA and IT.
 Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate closely with teams across the organization,
 such as QA, Product, and Architects, to gather data and understand business needs.
 IT and Technology Teams: Liaise with IT and technology teams to ensure the availability
 and functionality of necessary tools, platforms, and systems for data collection, storage,
analysis, and visualization.
 Who We Are Looking For
 3-5 years of development experience in .NET environment (C#)
 Experience in .Net Core programming and ecosystem
 Proven experience in writing Server-Side infrastructures
 Deep familiarity with OO design & development
 Motivated, hard worker, Independent and self-learner
 Experience in Multithreaded development
 Experience with Design patterns
 Advantage: Knowledge and Experience working with K8s
 Responsibility and high working moral
 Excellent interpersonal skills and service orientation
 Independent learning abilities
 Ability to work in Dynamic environment
 Excellent communication skills
 Team player
 Fluent in English (mandatory)
 More About Evoke
 We’re a business that embraces change and progress. The power behind big name brands
William Hill, 888 and Mr Green, evoke is the new name for 888 Holdings. Marking a new
sense of purpose, direction and ambition for the business, there couldn’t be a more
exciting time to join us as we accelerate our journey to bring even greater delight to our
customers with world-class experiences. That’s the future. That’s evoke.
At evoke, you’ll benefit from flexibility and a culture built on trust. We’ll give you the space
to be yourself and the tools you need to protect our customers while they play. We’ll invest
in your future to help you develop your unique strengths and build a career that’s right for
you.

employees, and communities. We foster a welcoming and safe workplace that values all
forms of diversity and provides opportunities for growth.
